claim(uint256,address).details: Net tokens go directly to to; only the fee is credited for withdrawal.      Claimed gross and the fee balance are updated before the token transfer.

params.to: Nonzero destination chosen exclusively by the recipient.

params.feeRecipient_: Nonzero address entitled to withdraw credited fees.
params.usdc_: ERC-20 token; intended to be Arc Testnet USDC.

createEscrow(address,address,uint256,uin.details: The deadline must be at least one hour away. An arbiter is optional,      but cannot be either party. No fee is charged at creation.

createPayroll(address,uint256,uint64,uin.details: Every nonfinal step is floor(amount / periods); the final step includes      all division remainder. Past starts are permitted if the end is future.

createVesting(address,uint256,uint64,uin.details: A cliff gates claims but does not reset linear accrual. Starts may be      in the past, provided the end remains strictly in the future.

params.cliffDuration: Offset from start; zero means no cliff.

release(uint256).details: Release authority remains available after the deadline until resolution.

revoke(uint256).details: Already vested entitlement remains claimable by the recipient forever.

withdraw(address).details: No additional fee. CEI and the shared guard protect all withdrawals.

FEE_BPS().notice: Fixed payout fee in basis points (0.2%), rounded down per payout.

balanceOf(address).notice: Pending credits, including fees, escrow proceeds and refunds.

claim(uint256,address).notice: Recipient claims all currently releasable gross entitlement.

createEscrow(address,address,uint256,uin.notice: Fund a conditional escrow; the payer is msg.sender.

createPayroll(address,uint256,uint64,uin.notice: Fund equal payroll steps; first payment vests after one full period.

createScheduled(address,uint256,uint64,b.notice: Fund an all-or-nothing payment unlocking at least one hour from now.

createVesting(address,uint256,uint64,uin.notice: Fund continuous linear vesting, optionally subject to revocation.

escrowCount().notice: Number of escrows created; IDs begin at 1.

feeRecipient().notice: Address credited with payout fees, permanently selected at deployment.

getEscrow(uint256).notice: Full configuration and resolution state; unknown IDs revert.

getPlan(uint256).notice: Full plan configuration and gross claim state; unknown IDs revert.

planCount().notice: Number of plans created; IDs begin at 1 independently of escrows.

refund(uint256).notice: Seller or designated arbiter may refund a funded escrow in full.

releasable(uint256).notice: Gross vested entitlement not yet claimed; unknown IDs revert.

release(uint256).notice: Payer or designated arbiter may release a funded escrow.

revoke(uint256).notice: Funder freezes a revocable plan and recovers only its unvested funds.

settleAfterDeadline(uint256).notice: Anyone can apply the pre-agreed outcome at or after the deadline.

usdc().notice: Payment token, permanently selected by the constructor.

vestedAmount(uint256).notice: Gross vested amount, permanently frozen at revocation if revoked.

withdraw(address).notice: Withdraw the caller's full credited balance to a nonzero destination.
